posts.zh:
beautiCode#deepseek-harness 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。为 DSH Web 设置本地图片与 MP4 视频背景：侧栏「背景」面板、可保存主题（含内置「画窗」）、声音开关、恢复上次背景，以及 /bg、/bg-theme、/bg-clear 命令。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-573aeef9560bdbf85d00.html
posts.en:
beautiCode#deepseek-harness is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Local image and MP4 video backgrounds for DSH Web: a sidebar Background panel, saved themes including a built-in window-frame preset, mute toggle, last-background restore, plus /bg, /bg-theme and /bg-clear commands.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-573aeef9560bdbf85d00.html
